verdict.rationale: Proa's own site says WCAG and WAI-ARIA checks run during cargo build, so common markup defects fail before deploy. That is built-in, development-time accessibility checking with no separate audit tool. It fits the documented compile-time template validation, but the claim is a single marketing line. missing for 10: detailed docs on which WCAG/ARIA rules are checked and how warnings are surfaced or configured, independent or hands-on corroboration that the checks work.
